text:
marta: Acme sec asked for a few items in their SQ — proof of KMS rotation, 24mo audit-log CSV export, and conditional access controls for service accounts. Can we get a concise answer I can paste into the form?

emily: Short answer: yes to all. We provide rotation metadata + cloud KMS events, can produce CSV audit exports (via admin API or scheduled pushes), and we have service-account protections (RBAC + conditional IP restrictions for Dedicated). Need to confirm exact CSV schema and any redaction policy for prompts.

raj: CSV schema we usually send: `timestamp,tenant_id,actor,action,resource,outcome,request_id,ip`. Example row: `2026-03-15T12:34:56Z,tenant_123,service-account:ingest,model.deploy,models/gpt-4x,success,req-abc123,34.56.78.90`

sasha: Acme also wants "rotation proof" specifically: key IDs + rotation timestamps + admin who triggered rotation. We rely on cloud KMS events for that. For Hosted we can export KMS audit events (CloudTrail / AuditLogs). For Private/Dedicated we can provide HSM rotation attestations. Is that sufficient?

emily: Yes. For Hosted: provide CMK metadata + KMS audit events that include `SetRotationSchedule` / `DisableKey` / `UpdateKey`. For Dedicated/Private: include HSM serials, rotation schedule, and ops approval logs. Also note: for hosted customers we do not share raw provider-managed key material.

leo: API snippet for CSV export we typically give ops:
```
POST /admin/audit/export HTTP/1.1
Host: console.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN
Content-Type: application/json

{ "tenant_id": "tenant_123", "start": "2024-03-01T00:00:00Z", "end": "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z", "format": "csv" }
```
Response: presigned S3 URL to download zip of CSVs. We also support scheduled push to customer S3/GCS via transfer config.

marta: Good. A few clarifying asks from the SQ: (1) They want full request bodies (prompts) by default — is that allowed? (2) Can we include conditional access (IP allowlist) for service accounts?

raj: (1) By default we redact prompt_text for Hosted — to reduce customer data exposure and PII. We can enable verbatim exports only under enterprise contract / NDA and with configured retention policies. Add a risk note.
(2) IP allowlist for service accounts is supported for Dedicated and Private. For Hosted we support delegated VPCs and egress IP locks for enterprise tiers; full per-service-account IP restrictions are available via dedicated deployments.

sasha: I'll draft the SQ text: bullet points for rotation proof, what logs we can provide, CSV schema example, how to request full-body exports (contract + controls), retention timelines (2yr cold, 90d UI), and conditional access caveats.

emily: Sample CSV (first 3 rows):
```
timestamp,tenant_id,actor,action,resource,outcome,request_id,ip
2026-03-15T12:34:56Z,tenant_123,svcacct:ingest,model.generate,models/gpt-4x,success,req-abc123,34.56.78.90
2026-03-15T12:35:01Z,tenant_123,user:alice,model.deploy,models/gpt-4x,success,req-abc124,34.56.78.90
```
Action: emily -> generate full sample CSV, KMS rotation export example, and a one-paragraph risk caveat about enabling prompt exports. Will attach to thread and send to marta by EOD.

deploy-bot: export job completed for tenant_123, file: s3://redwood-audit-exports/tenant_123/2026-03-15_export.zip (expires 7 days).

marta: Awesome — that's everything I need for the SQ. I'll paste the draft and ping legal for the NDA language for verbatim exports. Thanks all :thumbsup:
